root_cause.text: In ksmbd_tcp_new_connection(), when alloc_transport() fails, the function does not decrement the active_num_conn counter that was incremented earlier by ksmbd_kthread_fn(), causing a permanent leak of the connection slot.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains: "ksmbd_kthread_fn() increments active_num_conn before calling ksmbd_tcp_new_connection() and discards the return value, so when alloc_transport() returns NULL the socket is released and -ENOMEM returned without decrementing the counter." The patch adds `atomic_dec(&active_num_conn)` (gated on server_conf.max_connections) in the alloc_transport() failure path to fix the leak.
